digest.component_or_area: CLI commands: edit and claim with --review flags
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token and run review_plan(sign=True) after the EDIT commit, mapping verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040
claim --review must sense gate applicability via _plan_review_gate_applies, invoke llm.claim_gate_check and review_plan when applicable, and proceed to claim core only on PASS verdict

Both flags must exit with disposition-mapped codes (PASS→0, BLOCK→1, INDETERMINATE→2, retryable→11) and propagate exceptions through the standard CLI error handler without holding the store lock across the LLM request
claim --review must print a skip notice when the gate does not apply (disabled or exempt type) and continue without propagating --review through the parent cascade
Help texts must document non-atomicity and reference review-plan --status; docs/exit-codes.md must document the new --review exit codes while stating flagless contracts are unchanged
